fac_room_floor_building_address.name: fac_room_floor_building_address
fac_room_floor_building_address.body_sql:
SELECT
  fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY AS FAC_ROOM_KEY,
  fr.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
  fr.ROOM AS ROOM,
  fr.FLOOR AS FLOOR,
  ff.FLOOR_KEY AS FLOOR_KEY,
  fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
  fb.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  fba.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY__address,
  fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE AS ADDRESS_PURPOSE,
  fba.STREET_NUMBER AS STREET_NUMBER,
  fba.STREET_NAME AS STREET_NAME,
  fba.CITY AS CITY,
  fba.STATE AS STATE,
  fba.POSTAL_CODE AS POSTAL_CODE
FROM fac_rooms fr
LEFT JOIN fac_floor ff
  ON fr.FLOOR = ff.FLOOR -- preserve original stored join keys; carry through floor key
  AND fr.BUILDING_KEY = ff.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fac_building fb
  ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fac_building_address fba
  ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fba.BUILDING_KEY
fac_room_floor_building_address.description: Denormalized mapping of rooms to their floor, building and street address rows. One row per fac_rooms.FAC_ROOM_KEY (room instance) including building key and the address row(s) for that building (addresses not filtered here). Useful to join meet_place/building_room or building key to addresses.

iap_sessions_row_level.name: iap_sessions_row_level
iap_sessions_row_level.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.`TERM_CODE` AS `TERM_CODE`,
  -- carry key (grain) so downstream joins remain possible
  d.`IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY` AS `IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY`,
  -- expose stored max enrollment and attendance directly from iap_subject_detail
  d.`MAX_ENROLLMENT` AS `MAX_ENROLLMENT`,
  d.`ATTENDANCE` AS `ATTENDANCE`,
  -- canonicalize FEE: leave as-is when present, otherwise NULL (explicitly cast to NULLable)
  CASE WHEN d.`FEE` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(d.`FEE`) <> '' THEN d.`FEE` ELSE NULL END AS `FEE`,
  -- bring through cancellation flag; used to exclude cancelled rows in downstream queries if desired
  d.`IS_CANCELLED` AS `IS_CANCELLED`
FROM `iap_subject_detail` d
-- Exclude rows that are marked cancelled at the source when an IS_CANCELLED column exists and is truthy.
-- We still select IS_CANCELLED so callers can decide; however per requirement "exclude cancelled sessions when an IS_CANCELLED flag exists"
-- implement that exclusion here by filtering out values that indicate cancellation.
WHERE
  NOT (
    -- common cancellation indicators: 'Y', 'YES', '1', 'TRUE' (case-insensitive); NULL or empty means not cancelled
    d.`IS_CANCELLED` IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(UPPER(d.`IS_CANCELLED`)) IN ('Y','YES','1','TRUE')
  )
iap_sessions_row_level.description: One row per IAP session offering (raw records) from the iap_subject_detail table, canonicalizing fee nulls and exposing both MAX_ENROLLMENT and ATTENDANCE for downstream enrollment logic; exclude cancelled sessions when an IS_CANCELLED flag exists.

academic_terms_lookup.name: academic_terms_lookup
academic_terms_lookup.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- prefer the live academic_terms table when present; fall back to academic_terms_all or academic_term_parameter
  COALESCE(a.`TERM_CODE`, aa.`TERM_CODE`, ap.`TERM_CODE`) AS TERM_CODE,
  COALESCE(a.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`, aa.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`, ap.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`) AS TERM_DESCRIPTION
FROM
  `academic_terms` a
LEFT JOIN `academic_terms_all` aa
  ON a.`TERM_CODE` IS NULL AND aa.`TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL
LEFT JOIN `academic_term_parameter` ap
  ON a.`TERM_CODE` IS NULL
WHERE
  -- ensure we return rows coming from at least one source; lift literals out: consumer can filter TERM_CODE as needed
  (a.`TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL)
  OR (aa.`TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL AND a.`TERM_CODE` IS NULL)
  OR (ap.`TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL AND a.`TERM_CODE` IS NULL AND aa.`TERM_CODE` IS NULL)
academic_terms_lookup.description: Lookup rows for academic terms, exposing term code and term description from the available academic terms tables; prefer academic_terms table when present.

dept_course_level_agg.name: dept_course_level_agg
dept_course_level_agg.body_sql:
SELECT
  scd.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT,
  scd.COURSE_LEVEL AS COURSE_LEVEL,
  SUM(CASE WHEN scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CNT_U,
  SUM(CASE WHEN scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CNT_G,
  COUNT(*) AS CNT_TOTAL
FROM sis_course_description scd
WHERE scd.COURSE_LEVEL IN ('U','G')
GROUP BY
  scd.DEPARTMENT,
  scd.COURSE_LEVEL

semantic_filters.sis_course_description.COURSE_LEVEL: only include rows where COURSE_LEVEL IN ('U','G')

academic_term_lookup_precedence.name: academic_term_lookup_precedence
academic_term_lookup_precedence.body_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(at.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_CODE) AS TERM_CODE,
  -- TERM_DESCRIPTION must come from the table that provided the TERM_CODE value per precedence.
  CASE
    WHEN at.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN at.TERM_DESCRIPTION
    WHEN ata.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION
    ELSE atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION
  END AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  CASE
    WHEN at.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN at.IS_CURRENT_TERM
    WHEN ata.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM
    ELSE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM
  END AS IS_CURRENT_TERM,
  CASE
    WHEN at.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN 'academic_terms'
    WHEN ata.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN 'academic_terms_all'
    ELSE 'academic_term_parameter'
  END AS source_table
FROM
  -- start from the union of all TERM_CODEs to ensure one row per TERM_CODE
  (
    SELECT TERM_CODE FROM academic_terms WHERE TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT TERM_CODE FROM academic_terms_all WHERE TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT TERM_CODE FROM academic_term_parameter WHERE TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
  ) AS all_terms
LEFT JOIN academic_terms AS at
  ON all_terms.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN academic_terms_all AS ata
  ON all_terms.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN academic_term_parameter AS atp
  ON all_terms.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE
academic_term_lookup_precedence.description: Term metadata lookup by TERM_CODE with precedence: academic_terms first, then academic_terms_all, then academic_term_parameter. Exposes TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, IS_CURRENT_TERM and the source table the value came from. One row per TERM_CODE (coalesced from the three tables).

  NULL                                                            AS `SUBJECT_GROUPING_KEY`,

subject_summary_per_term_subject.name: subject_summary_per_term_subject

SELECT
  tso.TERM_CODE                                                  AS TERM_CODE,
  tso.SUBJECT_ID                                                 AS SUBJECT_ID,
  tso.SUBJECT_TITLE                                              AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
  -- SUBJECT_OR_CLUSTER: use SOURCE column SUBJECT_ID if available; otherwise fallback to SO_CLUSTER_TYPE is not allowed.
  -- The required column subject_summary.SUBJECT_OR_CLUSTER must come from a base table.
  -- Neither tip_subject_offered nor other available tables have a column named SUBJECT_OR_CLUSTER.
  -- However "tip_subject_offered" contains subject-level info; we'll expose MASTER_SUBJECT_ID as provided and
  -- create SUBJECT_OR_CLUSTER by using the stored column SUBJECT_ID (canonical subject identity) as the closest authoritative value.
  tso.SUBJECT_ID                                                  AS SUBJECT_OR_CLUSTER,
  tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID                                           AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
  -- Build a stable key for the subject_summary row by concatenating TERM_CODE and SUBJECT_ID.
  CONCAT(tso.TERM_CODE, '||', tso.SUBJECT_ID)                     AS SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY
FROM
  tip_subject_offered tso

  lmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AS LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY,
  -- keep the catalog's stored column; cast to integer when numeric as requested
  CASE
    WHEN TRIM(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED)
    WHEN lrc.CATALOG_YEAR IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE lrc.CATALOG_YEAR
  END AS CATALOG_YEAR,
  -- also expose the catalog PK from the catalog table (explicitly required)
  lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AS LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY__FROM_CATALOG
FROM
  library_reserve_matrl_detail lmd
  LEFT JOIN library_course_instructor lci
    ON lmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  LEFT JOIN library_reserve_catalog lrc
    ON lmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY

instructor_offerings_enrollment.body_sql:
SELECT
  so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID                                   AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
  so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME                                     AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
  so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY                                  AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
  so.TERM_CODE                                                    AS TERM_CODE,
  so.SUBJECT_ID                                                   AS SUBJECT_ID,
  so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS                                        AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
  lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID                                  AS LIBRARY_RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
  lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME                                    AS LIBRARY_RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
  lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY                                 AS LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
  lso.TERM_CODE                                                   AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE,
  lso.SUBJECT_ID                                                  AS LIBRARY_SUBJECT_ID,
  lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS                                       AS LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
  tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID                                  AS TIP_RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
  tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME                                    AS TIP_RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
  tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY                                     AS TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
  tso.TERM_CODE                                                   AS TIP_TERM_CODE,
  tso.SUBJECT_ID                                                  AS TIP_SUBJECT_ID,
  tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS                                       AS TIP_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
FROM
  -- primary subject offerings (canonical course/subject offering table)
  subject_offered so
  -- left join library offerings to bring their enrollment & instructor fields without collapsing rows
  LEFT JOIN library_subject_offered lso
    ON lso.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
    AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID
    AND lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
  -- left join tip offerings (separate offering source) to bring their enrollment & instructor fields
  LEFT JOIN tip_subject_offered_rows tso
    ON tso.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
    AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID
    AND tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID

Links instructor identifiers (responsible faculty MIT id and responsible faculty name) to enrollment measures from multiple offering tables. academic_term_codes.name: academic_term_codes
academic_term_codes.body_sql:
SELECT
  at.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  at.TERM_START_DATE AS TERM_START_DATE,
  at.TERM_END_DATE AS TERM_END_DATE,
  at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  at.TERM_STATUS AS TERM_STATUS,
  -- derived term type from TERM_CODE: expect codes like YYYYFA, YYYYSU, YYYYJA, YYYYSP etc.
  CASE
    WHEN RIGHT(at.TERM_CODE, 2) = 'FA' THEN 'FA'
    WHEN RIGHT(at.TERM_CODE, 2) = 'SP' THEN 'SP'
    WHEN RIGHT(at.TERM_CODE, 2) = 'JA' THEN 'JA'
    WHEN RIGHT(at.TERM_CODE, 2) = 'SU' THEN 'SU'
    -- some codes might use a single-letter season or different suffix; try common alternatives
    WHEN RIGHT(at.TERM_CODE, 1) = 'A' AND LENGTH(at.TERM_CODE) >= 2 THEN 'FA'
    WHEN RIGHT(at.TERM_CODE, 1) = 'P' AND LENGTH(at.TERM_CODE) >= 2 THEN 'SP'
    WHEN RIGHT(at.TERM_CODE, 1) = 'J' AND LENGTH(at.TERM_CODE) >= 2 THEN 'JA'
    WHEN RIGHT(at.TERM_CODE, 1) = 'S' AND LENGTH(at.TERM_CODE) >= 2 THEN 'SU'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS TERM_TYPE
FROM academic_terms AS at
GROUP BY
  at.TERM_CODE,
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  at.TERM_START_DATE,
  at.TERM_END_DATE,
  at.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  at.TERM_STATUS,
  TERM_TYPE
academic_term_codes.description: Reference of academic terms with term code, term description, term start/end, academic year and a derived term type (FA/SP/JA/SU) parsed from TERM_CODE — one row per TERM_CODE.

time_day_academic_fin_aid_periods.name: time_day_academic_fin_aid_periods
time_day_academic_fin_aid_periods.body_sql:
SELECT
  td.CALENDAR_DATE                                 AS CALENDAR_DATE,
  td.FISCAL_PERIOD                                 AS FISCAL_PERIOD,
  td.FISCAL_YEAR                                   AS FISCAL_YEAR,
  at.ACADEMIC_YEAR                                 AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR                            AS FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR
FROM
  -- base calendar days table (time_day) provides date and fiscal fields
  time_day td
  -- join to academic_terms_all to bring stored academic & financial aid year values
  LEFT JOIN academic_terms_all at
    -- join by matching the calendar date to a term's start/end range.
    -- academic_terms_all stores TERM_START_DATE and TERM_END_DATE as strings; compare as dates.
    ON STR_TO_DATE(td.CALENDAR_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') BETWEEN
       STR_TO_DATE(at.TERM_START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d')
       AND STR_TO_DATE(at.TERM_END_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d')

One row per building (fac_building.BUILDING_KEY). Keeps original building identifiers for joins and ordering.

fac_building_owned_sorted_for_reporting.name: fac_building_owned_sorted_for_reporting
fac_building_owned_sorted_for_reporting.body_sql:
SELECT
  fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY        AS BUILDING_KEY,
  fb.BUILDING_NUMBER         AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  fb.DATE_BUILT              AS DATE_BUILT,
  fb.DATE_OCCUPIED           AS DATE_OCCUPIED,
  fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE          AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  fb.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER  AS PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER,
  -- parsed year strings: attempt to extract 4-digit year from DATE_BUILT/DATE_OCCUPIED, else 'UNKNOWN'
  CASE
    WHEN fb.DATE_BUILT REGEXP '([0-9]{4})' THEN
      -- extract first 4-digit sequence
      SUBSTRING(fb.DATE_BUILT, REGEXP_INSTR(fb.DATE_BUILT, '[0-9]{4}'), 4)
    ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
  END AS BUILT_YEAR,
  CASE
    WHEN fb.DATE_OCCUPIED REGEXP '([0-9]{4})' THEN
      SUBSTRING(fb.DATE_OCCUPIED, REGEXP_INSTR(fb.DATE_OCCUPIED, '[0-9]{4}'), 4)
    ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
  END AS OCCUPIED_YEAR,
  -- ordering keys: convert parsed years to integers where possible, null when UNKNOWN
  NULLIF(
    CAST(
      CASE
        WHEN fb.DATE_BUILT REGEXP '([0-9]{4})' THEN SUBSTRING(fb.DATE_BUILT, REGEXP_INSTR(fb.DATE_BUILT, '[0-9]{4}'), 4)
        ELSE NULL
      END
    AS SIGNED), 0) AS BUILT_YEAR_INT,
  NULLIF(
    CAST(
      CASE
        WHEN fb.DATE_OCCUPIED REGEXP '([0-9]{4})' THEN SUBSTRING(fb.DATE_OCCUPIED, REGEXP_INSTR(fb.DATE_OCCUPIED, '[0-9]{4}'), 4)
        ELSE NULL
      END
    AS SIGNED), 0) AS OCCUPIED_YEAR_INT,
  -- row ordering tie-breakers: use building number and key so ordering is deterministic
  fb.BUILDING_NUMBER AS ORDERING_BUILDING_NUMBER,
  fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS ORDERING_BUILDING_KEY,
  -- suppression helper: previous (lag) built year and occupied year (caller can use to suppress repeats)
  LAG(
    CASE
      WHEN fb.DATE_BUILT REGEXP '([0-9]{4})' THEN SUBSTRING(fb.DATE_BUILT, REGEXP_INSTR(fb.DATE_BUILT, '[0-9]{4}'), 4)
      ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    END
  ) OVER (ORDER BY
      -- primary sort: built year nulls last, newest first (descending). Use INT when available.
      (CASE WHEN fb.DATE_BUILT REGEXP '([0-9]{4})' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(fb.DATE_BUILT, REGEXP_INSTR(fb.DATE_BUILT, '[0-9]{4}'),4) AS SIGNED) END) DESC,
      -- secondary: occupied year desc
      (CASE WHEN fb.DATE_OCCUPIED REGEXP '([0-9]{4})' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(fb.DATE_OCCUPIED, REGEXP_INSTR(fb.DATE_OCCUPIED, '[0-9]{4}'),4) AS SIGNED) END) DESC,
      fb.BUILDING_NUMBER,
      fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  ) AS PREV_BUILT_YEAR,
  LAG(
    CASE
      WHEN fb.DATE_OCCUPIED REGEXP '([0-9]{4})' THEN SUBSTRING(fb.DATE_OCCUPIED, REGEXP_INSTR(fb.DATE_OCCUPIED, '[0-9]{4}'), 4)
      ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    END
  ) OVER (ORDER BY
      (CASE WHEN fb.DATE_BUILT REGEXP '([0-9]{4})' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(fb.DATE_BUILT, REGEXP_INSTR(fb.DATE_BUILT, '[0-9]{4}'),4) AS SIGNED) END) DESC,
      (CASE WHEN fb.DATE_OCCUPIED REGEXP '([0-9]{4})' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(fb.DATE_OCCUPIED, REGEXP_INSTR(fb.DATE_OCCUPIED, '[0-9]{4}'),4) AS SIGNED) END) DESC,
      fb.BUILDING_NUMBER,
      fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  ) AS PREV_OCCUPIED_YEAR,
  -- final-row marker helper: total count window and row_number so caller can detect last row for summary
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY
      (CASE WHEN fb.DATE_BUILT REGEXP '([0-9]{4})' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(fb.DATE_BUILT, REGEXP_INSTR(fb.DATE_BUILT, '[0-9]{4}'),4) AS SIGNED) END) DESC,
      (CASE WHEN fb.DATE_OCCUPIED REGEXP '([0-9]{4})' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(fb.DATE_OCCUPIED, REGEXP_INSTR(fb.DATE_OCCUPIED, '[0-9]{4}'),4) AS SIGNED) END) DESC,
      fb.BUILDING_NUMBER,
      fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  ) AS ROW_NUM,
  COUNT(*) OVER () AS TOTAL_ROWS
FROM fac_building fb

semantic_filters.NONE: No intrinsic filter; keep all rows and let question_ops apply OWNERSHIP_TYPE/PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER filters.

fac_building_owned_sorted_for_reporting.description: Prepare an ordered building list for reporting: rows are one per building (fac_building.BUILDING_KEY) with parsed construction and occupancy years (as strings, 'UNKNOWN' where parsing fails) and ordering keys to support tie-suppression of repeated years and final summary row. fac_building_canonical.name: fac_building_canonical
fac_building_canonical.body_sql:
SELECT
  `fac_building`.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` AS `FAC_BUILDING_KEY`,
  `fac_building`.`BUILDING_NUMBER` AS `BUILDING_NUMBER`,
  `fac_building`.`BUILDING_NAME` AS `BUILDING_NAME`,
  -- Normalized BUILDING_USE: map common variants to a small set, leave NULLs as NULL
  CASE
    WHEN `fac_building`.`BUILDING_USE` IS NULL OR TRIM(`fac_building`.`BUILDING_USE`) = '' THEN NULL
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(`fac_building`.`BUILDING_USE`)) IN ('laboratory', 'lab', 'labs', 'research lab', 'research') THEN 'Laboratory'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(`fac_building`.`BUILDING_USE`)) IN ('academic', 'classroom', 'education', 'teaching') THEN 'Academic'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(`fac_building`.`BUILDING_USE`)) IN ('residential', 'residence', 'dorm', 'housing') THEN 'Residential'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(`fac_building`.`BUILDING_USE`)) IN ('administrative', 'administration', 'office') THEN 'Administrative'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(`fac_building`.`BUILDING_USE`)) IN ('mixed use', 'mixed-use', 'mixed') THEN 'Mixed Use'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(`fac_building`.`BUILDING_USE`)) IN ('service', 'utility', 'support') THEN 'Service'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(`fac_building`.`BUILDING_USE`)) IN ('parking', 'garage') THEN 'Parking'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(`fac_building`.`BUILDING_USE`)) IN ('retail', 'shop', 'shops') THEN 'Retail'
    ELSE `fac_building`.`BUILDING_USE`
  END AS `BUILDING_USE`,
  -- Ensure numeric area fields: treat NULL or non-numeric as NULL, otherwise preserve stored value
  CASE
    WHEN `fac_building`.`EXT_GROSS_AREA` IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE `fac_building`.`EXT_GROSS_AREA`
  END AS `EXT_GROSS_AREA`,
  CASE
    WHEN `fac_building`.`ASSIGNABLE_AREA` IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE `fac_building`.`ASSIGNABLE_AREA`
  END AS `ASSIGNABLE_AREA`,
  `fac_building`.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE` AS `WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
FROM `fac_building`
fac_building_canonical.description: Canonicalized building-level rows from the facility building table, with NULL handling for numeric area fields and a normalized BUILDING_USE label column.

fac_organization_hierarchy_indent.body_sql:
SELECT
  `fac_organization`.`ORGANIZATION_KEY` AS `ORGANIZATION_KEY`,
  -- carry through the stored ORGANIZATION_LEVEL exactly as requested
  `fac_organization`.`ORGANIZATION_LEVEL` AS `ORGANIZATION_LEVEL`,
  -- derive an integer indent_count based on numeric ORGANIZATION_LEVEL between 1 and 6.
  -- Non-parseable values or values outside 1..6 are treated as level 1 (no indent => 0)
  CASE
    WHEN CAST(`fac_organization`.`ORGANIZATION_LEVEL` AS SIGNED) BETWEEN 1 AND 6
      THEN GREATEST(0, CAST(`fac_organization`.`ORGANIZATION_LEVEL` AS SIGNED) - 1)
    ELSE 0
  END AS `indent_count`
FROM
  `fac_organization`
fac_organization_hierarchy_indent.description: Derives indentation (leading-space count) for organization names based on numeric ORGANIZATION_LEVEL between 1 and 6. Keeps non-parseable levels as level 1 (no indent). Does not perform text concatenation or final formatting — returns integer indent_count to be applied by presentation/query logic.

building_addresses_primary.name: building_addresses_primary
building_addresses_primary.body_sql:
SELECT
  fba.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
  fba.CITY AS CITY,
  fba.POSTAL_CODE AS POSTAL_CODE,
  fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE AS ADDRESS_PURPOSE,
  fbaf.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
  fbaf.CITY AS FCLT_CITY,
  fbaf.POSTAL_CODE AS FCLT_POSTAL_CODE,
  fbaf.ADDRESS_PURPOSE AS FCLT_ADDRESS_PURPOSE
FROM (
  SELECT
    fba_inner.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY fba_inner.BUILDING_KEY
      ORDER BY CASE WHEN fba_inner.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'PRIMARY' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
               fba_inner.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE DESC,
               fba_inner.POSTAL_CODE ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM fac_building_address fba_inner
) fba
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    fbaf_inner.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY fbaf_inner.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
      ORDER BY CASE WHEN fbaf_inner.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'PRIMARY' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
               fbaf_inner.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE DESC,
               fbaf_inner.POSTAL_CODE ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM fclt_building_address fbaf_inner
) fbaf ON fba.BUILDING_KEY = fbaf.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WHERE fba.rn = 1
  AND fbaf.rn = 1

iap_detail_normalized.name: iap_detail_normalized
iap_detail_normalized.body_sql:
SELECT
  `iap_subject_detail`.`IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY` AS IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY,
  `iap_subject_detail`.`IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY` AS IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY,
  `iap_subject_detail`.`IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY` AS IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
  `iap_subject_detail`.`TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE,
  -- canonicalized numeric attendance: when ATTENDANCE is numeric (integer or float-looking) cast to signed,
  -- otherwise map NULL or non-numeric to 0. Preserve raw value in source table (not returned here per spec).
  CASE
    WHEN `iap_subject_detail`.`ATTENDANCE` IS NULL OR TRIM(`iap_subject_detail`.`ATTENDANCE`) = '' THEN 0
    WHEN `iap_subject_detail`.`ATTENDANCE` REGEXP '^[+-]?[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(`iap_subject_detail`.`ATTENDANCE` AS SIGNED)
    WHEN `iap_subject_detail`.`ATTENDANCE` REGEXP '^[+-]?[0-9]*\\.[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(FLOOR(CAST(`iap_subject_detail`.`ATTENDANCE` AS DECIMAL(38,10))) AS SIGNED)
    ELSE 0
  END AS ATTENDANCE
FROM `iap_subject_detail`
iap_detail_normalized.description: One row per iap_subject_detail with cleaned/canonicalized numeric ATTENDANCE and preserved foreign keys to sponsor and session. Converts ATTENDANCE to integer when numeric; non-numeric or NULL mapped to 0 and raw_attendance preserved.

  `iap_subject_detail`.`IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY` AS IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,

  `iap_subject_detail`.`TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE,
  `iap_subject_detail`.`ATTENDANCE` AS ATTENDANCE,
  `iap_subject_sponsor`.`SPONSOR_NAME` AS SPONSOR_NAME,
  `iap_subject_session`.`SESSION_START_TIME` AS SESSION_START_TIME,
  `iap_subject_session`.`IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY` AS IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY__from_session
FROM `iap_subject_detail`
JOIN `iap_subject_category`
  ON `iap_subject_detail`.`IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY` = `iap_subject_category`.`IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY`
LEFT JOIN `iap_subject_sponsor`
  ON `iap_subject_detail`.`IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY` = `iap_subject_sponsor`.`IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY`
LEFT JOIN `iap_subject_session`
  ON `iap_subject_detail`.`IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY` = `iap_subject_session`.`IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY`
iap_category_joins.description: Denormalized rows joining iap_subject_category -> iap_subject_detail -> iap_subject_sponsor -> iap_subject_session, preserving keys and attributes needed to compute category-level aggregates; one row per iap_subject_detail (so categories without details will not produce rows, but iap_subject_category is still referenced in final query to include empty categories).

fac_organization_core.name: fac_organization_core
fac_organization_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  fo.ORGANIZATION_KEY AS ORGANIZATION_KEY,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_ID AS ORGANIZATION_ID,
  -- prefer the stored ORGANIZATION_NAME from fac_organization; if NULL, coalesce to empty string to "clean up NULLs"
  COALESCE(fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, '') AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER AS ORGANIZATION_NUMBER,
  -- ORGANIZATION_LEVEL is kept as stored; coalesce to 0 when missing to avoid NULLs (but keep numeric-ish typing)
  COALESCE(fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL, '0') AS ORGANIZATION_LEVEL,
  COALESCE(fo.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, '') AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM fac_organization fo
fac_organization_core.description: Normalized one-row-per-organization with canonical id, name, number, level, hierarchy type and break-group-like fields. Clean up NULLs but do not aggregate members. Exposes columns needed to join to member/emeritus counts and to format names by level.

hr_faculty_roster_flagged.name: hr_faculty_roster_flagged
hr_faculty_roster_flagged.body_sql:
SELECT
  `hr_faculty_roster`.`MIT_ID` AS `MIT_ID`,
  `hr_faculty_roster`.`LAST_NAME` AS `LAST_NAME`,
  `hr_faculty_roster`.`FIRST_NAME` AS `FIRST_NAME`,
  -- Canonicalize emeritus status: normalize common truthy values to 'EMERITUS', else 'ACTIVE'
  CASE
    WHEN `hr_faculty_roster`.`EMERITUS_STATUS` IS NULL THEN 'ACTIVE'
    WHEN TRIM(BOTH ' ' FROM UPPER(`hr_faculty_roster`.`EMERITUS_STATUS`)) IN ('Y','YES','TRUE','T','1','EMERITUS') THEN 'EMERITUS'
    ELSE 'ACTIVE'
  END AS `EMERITUS_STATUS`,
  `hr_faculty_roster`.`HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE` AS `HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE`,
  `hr_faculty_roster`.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE` AS `WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
FROM `hr_faculty_roster`
hr_faculty_roster_flagged.description: One row per faculty roster entry (person) with emeritus flag canonicalized. Exposes MIT_ID and the emergitus status indicator suitable for grouping and counting emeritus vs non-emeritus members per organization. Keeps join keys to organization via HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE (available in this chunk) — caller can join to fac_organization via matching keys provided in question_ops.

subject_offered_clean_meet_place.name: subject_offered_clean_meet_place
subject_offered_clean_meet_place.body_sql:
SELECT
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`SECTION_ID`      AS `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`SUBJECT_ID`      AS `SUBJECT_ID`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`SUBJECT_TITLE`   AS `SUBJECT_TITLE`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`TERM_CODE`       AS `TERM_CODE`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`MEET_PLACE`      AS `MEET_PLACE`,
  -- extracted leading building token before first space or hyphen (NULL if MEET_PLACE is NULL/empty)
  NULLIF(
    TRIM(
      SUBSTRING_INDEX(
        SUBSTRING_INDEX(`course_catalog_subject_offered`.`MEET_PLACE`, ' ', 1),
        '-', 1
      )
    ),
    ''
  ) AS `meet_building_number`
FROM
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`
WHERE
  -- ensure TERM_CODE present (lifted literal; may be replaced at query time)
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL
subject_offered_clean_meet_place.description: Normalize subject_offered rows with cleaned MEET_PLACE building token and ensure term_code present; extract building_number token (leading token before space or hyphen) from MEET_PLACE into meet_building_number and keep core course fields.

tip_material_normalized.name: tip_material_normalized
tip_material_normalized.body_sql:
SELECT
  `tip_material`.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY` AS `TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`,
  `tip_material`.`YEAR` AS `YEAR`,
  `tip_material`.`TITLE` AS `TITLE`,
  `tip_material`.`NEW_SHELF_PRICE` AS `NEW_SHELF_PRICE`,
  -- canonicalized title: trim and collapse internal whitespace, null-preserve
  (CASE WHEN `tip_material`.`TITLE` IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(`tip_material`.`TITLE`), '\\s+', ' ')
  END) AS `CANONICAL_TITLE`,
  -- title length (NULL-aware): length of canonical title, NULL if source TITLE is NULL
  (CASE WHEN `tip_material`.`TITLE` IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE CHAR_LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(`tip_material`.`TITLE`), '\\s+', ' '))
  END) AS `TITLE_LENGTH`
FROM

iap_subject_detail_clean.name: iap_subject_detail_clean
iap_subject_detail_clean.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AS IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY,
  d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY AS IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY,
  d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY AS IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
  d.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  d.ACTIVITY_TITLE AS ACTIVITY_TITLE,
  p.PERSON_ROLE AS PERSON_ROLE,
  d.FEE AS FEE,
  d.IS_CANCELLED AS IS_CANCELLED
FROM iap_subject_detail d
LEFT JOIN iap_subject_person_lookup p
  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY
WHERE
  -- exclude rows with obviously invalid/empty-string keys for the canonical composite key parts
  d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY <> ''
  AND d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY <> ''
  AND d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY <> ''
  -- also exclude rows where the primary identifying fields are NULL
  AND d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY IS NOT NULL
  AND d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY IS NOT NULL
  AND d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY IS NOT NULL

semantic_filters.exclude_empty_person_key: IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY) <> ''

iap_subject_detail_clean.description: Normalized/cleaned iap_subject_detail rows: canonical keys, preserve fee and category/person foreign keys, and exclude obviously invalid empty-string keys. One row per iap_subject_detail record (identified by its composite keys as in source).

iap_subject_person_core.name: iap_subject_person_core
iap_subject_person_core.description: Canonical person rows for IAP subjects: one row per iap_subject_person identified by IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY, exposing PERSON_ROLE and PERSON_NAME for grouping and distinct counting (fallback to PERSON_NAME if key missing).

iap_category_core.name: iap_category_core
iap_category_core.description: IAP category lookup: one row per iap_subject_category exposing the category key and IAP_CATEGORY_NAME for grouping.

fac_floor_rows_clean.name: fac_floor_rows_clean
fac_floor_rows_clean.body_sql:
SELECT
  `fac_floor`.`BUILDING_KEY` AS `BUILDING_KEY`,
  `fac_floor`.`FLOOR` AS `FLOOR`,
  `fac_floor`.`FLOOR_KEY` AS `FLOOR_KEY`,
  `fac_floor`.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE` AS `WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
FROM `fac_floor`
WHERE `fac_floor`.`FLOOR` IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(`fac_floor`.`FLOOR`) <> ''
fac_floor_rows_clean.description: Row-level cleaned subset of fac_floor excluding NULL/empty FLOOR values; exposes building and floor identifiers for counting distinct floors per building.

building_floor_distinct_counts.name: building_floor_distinct_counts
building_floor_distinct_counts.body_sql:
SELECT
  `fac_floor`.`BUILDING_KEY` AS `BUILDING_KEY`,
  `fac_floor`.`FLOOR` AS `FLOOR`
FROM `fac_floor`
GROUP BY
  `fac_floor`.`BUILDING_KEY`,
  `fac_floor`.`FLOOR`
building_floor_distinct_counts.description: Distinct floor count per building computed from fac_floor rows (excluding NULL/empty floors). One row per building with the number of distinct floors.

subject_offered_summer_sections.name: subject_offered_summer_sections
subject_offered_summer_sections.body_sql:
SELECT
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`SECTION_ID` AS `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`TERM_CODE` AS `TERM_CODE`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`SUBJECT_ID` AS `SUBJECT_ID`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`SUBJECT_TITLE` AS `SUBJECT_TITLE`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME` AS `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`MEET_TIME` AS `MEET_TIME`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`MEET_PLACE` AS `MEET_PLACE`
FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered`
WHERE `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`TERM_CODE` LIKE '%SU'
subject_offered_summer_sections.description: All subject_offered rows corresponding to summer term offerings (term code ends with 'SU'). Exposes subject and instructor name columns for downstream cleaning and aggregation.

moira_list_rows_173.name: moira_list_rows_173
moira_list_rows_173.description: One row per mailing list in moira_list. Exposes the mailing list key and basic attributes; useful to join to owners and list details.

moira_list_detail_rows.name: moira_list_detail_rows
moira_list_detail_rows.body_sql:
SELECT
  `moira_list_detail`.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` AS `MOIRA_LIST_KEY`,
  `moira_list_detail`.`MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY` AS `MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY`,
  `moira_list_detail`.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER` AS `MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER`,
  `moira_list_detail`.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID` AS `MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID`
FROM
  `moira_list_detail`
moira_list_detail_rows.description: One row per moira_list_detail entry (membership / owner linkage). Exposes which member belongs to which list and the list owner key when present. Keep one row per moira_list_detail record so downstream aggregations (counts) can be computed externally.

mit_student_directory_by_department.name: mit_student_directory_by_department
mit_student_directory_by_department.body_sql:
SELECT
  `mit_student_directory`.`FULL_NAME` AS `FULL_NAME`,
  `mit_student_directory`.`DEPARTMENT` AS `DEPARTMENT`
FROM `mit_student_directory`
WHERE `mit_student_directory`.`DEPARTMENT` IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(`mit_student_directory`.`DEPARTMENT`) <> ''
mit_student_directory_by_department.description: One row per student from mit_student_directory restricted to rows with a non-empty department code. Exposes student identifiers, full name and department for downstream grouping and name-length calculations.

sis_admin_department_contact.name: sis_admin_department_contact
sis_admin_department_contact.body_sql:
SELECT
  `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  `DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE` AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE,
  `DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER` AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
  `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE` AS SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE
FROM `sis_admin_department`
sis_admin_department_contact.description: One row per SIS administrative department code exposing the official department name and a normalized department phone number composed from area code and number when both parts are present (NULL otherwise).

students_per_department_aggregates.name: students_per_department_aggregates
students_per_department_aggregates.body_sql:
SELECT
  `mit_student_directory`.`DEPARTMENT` AS `DEPARTMENT`,
  COUNT(*) AS `FULL_NAME_count`,
  MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(`mit_student_directory`.`FULL_NAME`)) AS `FULL_NAME`
FROM `mit_student_directory`
GROUP BY `mit_student_directory`.`DEPARTMENT`
students_per_department_aggregates.description: Pre-aggregated one row per department (using mit_student_directory.DEPARTMENT) giving student count and longest full-name length. Keeps the department key as grain so it can be joined to SIS department metadata.
